top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employee records evaluated was unavailable for review.     One out of four employee records evaluated was incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Records- Training Hours (26 TAC §747.901(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The required 30 clock hours of training for the primary caregiver was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Re-cite: Documentation of drills was not available for review at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Access to Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.909)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During inspection licensing did not have access to staff records.

top_violation_types.title: Provide Access to Children's Records - Licensing (26 TAC §746.601(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Only 12 records of the 21 children enrolled were made available to Child Care Regulation at the time of the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child in care did not have an immunization record available for review.
